tools.name: generate_install_command
tools.description: Generate the terminal installation command for agentic-go based on package manager, operating system, and architecture.

method.description: Installation method: brew (Homebrew tap), curl (shell installer), or binary (direct release archive)

os.description: Target operating system (darwin for macOS, linux for Linux)

arch.description: Target CPU architecture (arm64 for Apple Silicon/ARM64, amd64 for Intel/x86_64)

tools.name: generate_mcp_config
tools.description: Generate JSON configuration snippet for connecting agentic-go with AI coding clients including Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, or Claude Code.

workspace_path.description: Absolute file path to the target Go workspace directory (defaults to current directory .)

tools.name: get_contract_specification
tools.description: Returns the official schema specification, invariants, and purpose of an agentic-go protocol contract.

contract.description: Protocol contract to retrieve (context: agentic.context/v1, change: agentic.change/v1, verify: agentic.verify/v1)

tools.name: get_faq_answers
tools.description: Query frequently asked questions and official architectural answers regarding agentic-go, gopls integration, sandboxing, and refactoring safety.

topic.description: Optional FAQ keyword or topic filter (e.g. gopls, git, sandbox, toolchain, open-weight)

tools.name: get_quickstart
tools.description: Returns ready-to-run installation commands, Homebrew formula, curl installer, and MCP stdio config for agentic-go.

tools.name: get_tool_catalog
tools.description: Returns the complete frozen surface inventory of agentic-go v1.0.0: 14 tools, 7 resources, 1 resource template, and 6 prompts.

tools.name: get_verification_sample
tools.description: Returns a canonical agentic.verify/v1 verification report payload with whole-package test evidence, race reports, and calibrated uncertainty.

step.description: Optional verification pipeline stage to inspect

tools.name: inspect_verification_step
tools.description: Inspect and navigate to a specific step of the interactive verification pipeline explorer on the page.

step.description: The verification pipeline stage to inspect

tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search agentic-go documentation topics, routes, capabilities, and protocol contracts.

query.description: Search keyword or topic (e.g. install, verify, gopls, mcp, contracts)
